_comment: BRAND REGISTRY v1.0. Identical in every brand kit. One place that knows every brand in the house. An agent reads this to resolve a brand name to its CDN root, palette, tokens and logo files without knowing per-brand filenames. Adding a brand means adding one entry here plus the files it points at. See NEW-BRAND.md.

shared._comment: Identical in every kit. Served from the parent brand because the type layer belongs to Collective Edge and is inherited down.

logoRoles._comment: Every brand maps the first five roles. Ask for a role, never for a filename. `-on-light` means the version to place ON a light background; `-on-dark` the version to place ON a dark background. The compact pair is optional and present only where a brand ships a short lockup; absent when it does not.
logoRoles.compact-on-light: the short lockup, for smaller places, decks, or a corner, light backgrounds
logoRoles.compact-on-dark: the short lockup, for smaller places, decks, or a corner, dark backgrounds
logoRoles.stacked-on-dark: optional vertical lockup; null when the brand has none

collective-edge.name: Collective Edge
collective-edge.colorNote: Collective Edge has no hue of its own. It runs on a grey ramp. On a co-brand surface the Edge wedge takes the PARTNER's hue.

cobrandMarks._comment: The Edge wedge carries the partner's hue. Every combination ships as a file. Never hand-recolor a mark.

heroTreatment._comment: Collective Edge signature. Apex and Royal do not use it; their dark bands are flat brand color. Title slides, section dividers and the marketing hero only, once per surface. Never behind body copy, never on an internal document.

slideBackground._comment: Scrim already composited. Drop straight onto a PowerPoint or Keynote slide as a picture background. No CSS, no further work.

safeZonesForReversedType._comment: Worst-pixel contrast against #FFFFFF, measured on the shipped asset. The wave puts its light upper-left.

apex.name: Apex Paramedics
apex.colorNote: Blue is the structure, gold is the spark. Bright gold #FDB61C measures 1.77:1 on white and fails contrast as text there. Use #B77808, and only at bold or large sizes. Gold is a brand accent, never a status colour.
apex.logoNote: The main logo is APEX PARAMEDICS, the horizontal lockup. The compact lockup is APEX alone, for smaller places, decks, or a corner. The delivered compact files carried #000F9F and #FFB71B; both are normalised to the primary lockup so the house ships one blue and one gold, and the delivered originals are kept in assets/logos/_superseded/.

royal.name: Royal Ambulance
royal.colorNote: Purple is the whole palette. #43205b is the logo fill. Light purple #8260a2 is for tertiary accents and hover only, never text on white.

diagramRoles._comment: Functional colors for flowcharts, status and dashboards. Identical across every brand so a diagram reads the same regardless of whose document it sits in. Never invent new hues for these roles. A brand accent is never a status color. Each role names the text color that clears contrast on it; measured, do not substitute.

decision.textRule: large or bold only, which is what a node label is. Never body copy on this fill.

warning.textRule: near-black, not white. White on this amber measures 2.70:1 and fails at every size.

diagramRoles.shape: rectangles, 6px radius. Role is communicated by fill color, never by shape.

unreconciled._comment: No brand kit exists for these. Inherited from an original design export and NOT verified against a source of truth. Confirm before use in anything shipping.
